requirements: All candidate and test-only adaptation input rows are fixed to the actually verified published base e8941c2235069a168d9b6d92a0e9e1a62acce296. Verify every raw size/hash/Git blob before use; do not infer missing source data or reuse prior runtime grades.

Before a new claim or test, reconcile the predecessor WP-NATURAL-SAVE-BOOL-20261008-001 remote reviewable terminal state with the existing repository-wide local durable ledger, shared lock, recorded owned processes/handles and job/reader cleanup. A remote terminal report alone is not proof of local release. Do not delete, steal or overwrite the old claim/lock; if unresolved, report blocked and do not relaunch the predecessor task. The new regression runs below are only against the changed owned-staging candidate.

This task is test-only. Stage immutable exact production inputs into a fresh disposable public-v30 test copy with the unchanged inherited Natural identity engine, published owned-staging adapter and its exact six tests. Copying pinned inputs for the test copy is permitted; production source edits, source-patch adjustments, adoption or Raw combination are not.

Run the independently bound mkdir semantics probe first on the existing previously verified target Godot binary under the unchanged Windows guard, in a minimal disposable no-autoload isolated project. The probe must not preload the candidate adapter. Bind the existing executable path/hash and actual version receipt; do not replace/install an engine or silently substitute the official tag binary. If this prerequisite fails, is unrun or lacks strict guard acceptance, stop all candidate-dependent parsing/tests and report blocked; do not work around it.

The runtime receipt 4.6.3.stable.official.7d41c59c4 could not be resolved in official source (HTTP422). Official tag commit 35e80b3a8822a9df9be390814b62f44c0a9c69e8 supplies source rationale only. A successful mkdir probe demonstrates its observed existing-binary behavior, not full binary/source provenance.

Only after the mkdir prerequisite really passes: parse the candidate, run the new focused five write-result cases and owned-staging tests, and compile four blank Natural objects. Keep candidate/test hashes exact; only minimal new isolated wrappers and receipt collectors within the allowed test path may be added.

Run test_cleanup_diagnostic.gd separately. Its intentional production ERROR must stay in raw stderr/guard evidence and be classified as expected diagnostic observation with strict_pass=false or the actual strict-guard failure; never suppress the ERROR, weaken the guard, change nonzero evidence or merge this into strict passing totals.

The old exact three-Dictionary suite hash 60e46a3b5b607d3ba5cbe3634ebcd6bd3ebbfc98fa10d4bad8732ea95b5a0ba2 remains historical immutable provenance. Its path+.tmp failure fixture no longer targets the private staging backend. Use only the separately published test-only adaptation with explicit open-failure injection and exactly-one open call evidence; retain the existing failure/live-state/old-destination assertion meaning.

Use the fully pinned adaptation ae391e16f204575beef057c245430dc8a830e4b9611f34683988ee42497052f8 to run coastal_range and plateau_hinterland separately, each retaining the original 170 checks including 13 T03 checks. Do not move new owned/focused cases into those counts, hard-code passing counters, substitute old receipts or rewrite prior manifests.

Every run is serial, headless Small guard 1GiB Job/120s/64KiB aggregate output/512MiB reserve with stricter existing rules preserved. Confirm both OS user directory and globalized user:// isolation before test bodies; no autoload, Main, UI, editor, live AI or actual player data.

Report actual passed/failed/unrun/expected-diagnostic stages, executed source and entry-wrapper hashes, before/after source maps, terminal Job/readers/owned-handle/host exits, and exact isolated-only traversal-policy restoration. The existing bound suite may run its already established temporary traversal-policy counterexample only in its disposable copy and must restore exact bytes; this is not a new production edit or permission to change the source outside that fixture. Job commit memory must not be labeled physical RSS.

Retain cooperative owned-staging scope limits: no claim of target CAS, all-writer lock, external symlink/replacement protection, actual disk short writes, real OS concurrency, crash/power-loss durability or target-preserving failed native rename. Preserve recovery payload observations on rename failure.

Use current STOP/CONTROL and verified unique new-task claim rules. Source-channel review does not authorize unattended worker deployment: keep automation_enabled=false until existing worker entry and end-to-end canary are actually established. On every safe task end apply the existing real-reported context/checkpoint/available-native-compaction rule without guessing.

Publish only this new test/evidence candidate root and exact new-task results. Preserve the original production candidate, adaptation directory, manifests, prior tests/results/claims and root protocol/schema/README. Two-phase CAS fast-forward publication and remote readback remain required.
